title: Bhaari cheez pehle girti hai?
description: Season 2 Episode 5: Gravity pulls heavy things harder, but heavy things are equally harder to move — so everything falls with the same acceleration.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 2 (free fall, g independent of mass)
exam_focus: JEE/NEET: free fall, why a = g for all masses
hook_text: Bowling ball vs Tennis ball — kaun pehle? 🎳🎾
concept: Gravity pulls heavy things harder, but heavy things are equally harder to move — so everything falls with the same acceleration.
on_screen_cues: "F = mg (zyada)" + "a = F/m (mass cancel!)" → "a = g = 9.8 m/s² for ALL" → "Apollo 15, 1971 🔨🪶" → "NCERT XI Ch 2 · Free fall"
pinned_comment: Hawa mein bowling ball aur tennis ball mein kaun pehle girega? (Trick hai 😏)
suggested_titles: "Bhaari cheez pehle girti hai? Galileo vs Aristotle" / "Moon pe hammer aur feather saath gire 🤯"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [confidently] Chintu, ek bowling ball aur ek tennis ball saath chhodo... bowling ball pehle giregi. Obviously.
Chintu: [mischievously] Kyun?
Gudiya: [confused] Kyunki woh bhaari hai! Gravity zyada kheenchti hai!
Chintu: [excited] Sahi! Bhaari cheez ko gravity ZYADA kheenchti hai...
Gudiya: [cheerfully] Dekha!
Chintu: [deadpan] ...lekin bhaari cheez ko HILAANA bhi utna hi zyada mushkil hai!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Ohh... zyada force, zyada mass... dono cancel?
Chintu: [elated] Exactly! Isliye har cheez ka acceleration SAME hai. 9 point 8 metre per second square. Chahe patthar ho ya pankh.
Gudiya: [surprised] Pankh?! Pankh toh dheere girta hai!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Woh hawa ki wajah se! Hawa hatao, toh...
Gudiya: [curious] Toh?
Chintu: [dramatic tone] 1971. Apollo 15. Astronaut David Scott ne Moon pe ek hammer aur ek pankh saath chhode...
Gudiya: [gasps] Aur?
Chintu: [excited] Dono EK SAATH gire! Bilkul same time!
Gudiya: [elated] Matlab hawa hi villain thi! Gravity toh sabko barabar treat karti hai!
Chintu: [proudly] Galileo ne 400 saal pehle yahi bola tha. Moon pe proof mil gaya.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh ek bullet gun se chalao aur ek haath se chhodo... kaun pehle giregi?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
